exposure: delivery in private facilities vs public facilities
educational status of women and their husbands
distance to the nearest health facility from the household
presence of complications during pregnancy and the last childbirth
cohort: 2,768 women of 15-49 years of age who had delivery within one year prior to data collection, living in hard-to-reach areas of Bangladesh
finding: The study found that the prevalence of C-sections in four hard-to-reach areas of Bangladesh is substantially below the national average, although it was higher in coastal areas than three other regions, and was associated with delivery location, residential area, and complications during childbirth.
